contentBlocks.title: SASSA Required Documents Checklist
contentBlocks.description: Having the right documents ready speeds up your SASSA grant application. Use our complete checklist to make sure you have everything you need — from your ID to bank statements and medical reports.

contentBlocks.text: Having the correct documents ready before you apply for a SASSA grant will save you time and prevent delays. Below is the complete checklist of documents you may need.
This guide is for anyone preparing to apply for a SASSA grant who wants to make sure they have all the required documents ready before visiting a SASSA office.

documents.label: Original 13-digit barcoded Smart Card ID or green ID book
Proof of Residence — utility bill in your name (last 3 months)
documents.notes: Or letter from traditional leader or ward councillor

documents.label: Last 3 months bank statements showing all deposits
Sworn affidavit confirming unemployment (stamped at SAPS)
Marriage certificate, divorce order, or death certificate of spouse
SASSA medical assessment report
documents.notes: For Disability Grant and Care Dependency Grant
